name: Aqara Light Switch H2, 1 Channel (US)

radios.note: Runs Matter over Thread by default or Zigbee with an Aqara hub; Bluetooth is for setup.

matter.note: Aqara's page states Matter over Thread. CSA lists the Light Switch H2 US (2 Button, 1 Channel) from Lumi United (Aqara's maker): Matter 1.3, certified 2024-09-09, certificate CSA244D0MAT43907-24. The search only surfaced CSA's Portuguese-language copy of the listing.

apple_home.note: Thread mode needs a Thread-enabled Matter controller, such as an Apple TV or HomePod that is a Thread border router.

google_home.note: Needs a Thread-capable Google hub or speaker as Matter controller.

alexa.note: Needs a Thread-capable Echo as Matter controller.

smartthings.note: Aqara's compatibility list names SmartThings. In Thread mode Aqara says the ecosystem needs a Thread-enabled Matter controller, here a Thread-capable SmartThings hub.

home_assistant.note: Through Home Assistant's Matter integration, which needs a Thread border router. Zigbee mode through an Aqara hub is the alternative.

hubRequired.note: Thread mode needs no Aqara hub, only a Thread border router for the Matter controller. Zigbee mode does need an Aqara Zigbee hub.

localControl.note: Matter controllers reach it locally over Thread. Aqara doesn't state local control for its own app.

switchForm.note: Replaces a US wall switch; single-pole and 3-way setups.

dimmer.note: On/off only. Aqara sells a separate Dimmer Switch H2 US.

neutralRequired.note: Works with or without a neutral. Power monitoring and overload protection need one; without it the minimum load is 5 W.

gangs.note: Aqara's spec sheet lists this as model WS-K02E. The 2-button 2-channel (WS-K03E) and 4-button 3-channel (WS-K04E) versions are separate models.

summary: The Aqara Light Switch H2 (US) is a wall switch with two buttons and one relay channel. It works with or without a neutral wire. By default it uses Matter over Thread, so Apple Home, Google Home, Alexa, SmartThings and Home Assistant can add it without an Aqara hub, given a Thread-capable Matter controller. In Zigbee mode it needs an Aqara hub instead. Power monitoring needs a neutral.
caveats: Thread mode needs a Matter controller that is also a Thread border router.
Aqara recommends Zigbee mode with an Aqara hub for full features; some are limited through third-party Matter.
Without a neutral wire there is a 5 W minimum load, and no power monitoring or overload protection.
Versions with other button and channel counts have different model numbers; check the box.
